newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Transportation firm Mitra up on debut.
newsitem.headline: Transportation firm Mitra up on debut.

text.p: Indonesian land transportation firm PT Mitra Rajasa rose 250 rupiah from its offer price of 1,175 rupiah per share on its debut on the Jakarta exchange on Thursday.
After 30 minutes of trading, Mitra eased to 1,275 rupiah but topped the active list with a turnover of 10.9 million shares on profit-taking, brokers said.
Brokers said sentiment on the stock was relatively strong but they doubted it could rise further as some investors were just seeking short-term gains.
Mitra Rajasa offfered 30 million shares during its January 13-15 public offer period to raise about 35.3 billion rupiah.
The company said 75 percent of the proceeds will be used to finance its expansion programme, including purchasing 150 trucks, and in maintaining its existing truck fleet.
It said 10 percent of the proceeds will be used to finance its fleet workshop, eight percent to increase its equity participation in subsidiaries and the remaining seven percent to repay loans.
